background: Rachael Knust is the Campbell County treasurer, serving through the end of the current term in January 2027. The county's official treasurer page states that she was elected to finish the term of Becky Brazelton, who was elected treasurer in 2015, and that she has worked in the office since 1980. Incoming treasurer Crystal Conley, who won the 2026 election, takes office in January 2027.
